name: sentinel-fabricator-summon-buffed-drone
notes: The activated ability's prereq requires Status==2 (awake), so it's patched explicitly. The 3-reserve cost queues 3 reps of the myHand-0 reserve-payment decision before summoning the token; an unrelated post-resolution opportunity to activate the ability again is declined with PASS.

rulesClauses: (3), REST: Summon an Automaton Drone token with a buff counter on it.
